name: Owlman
description: A winged humanoid cryptid reported around the parish church of St Mawnan and St Stephen in Cornwall, England, in 1976 and a handful of subsequent years. The case is heavily entangled with the self-described wizard and showman Tony 'Doc' Shiels, and is widely considered a hoax or folkloric construction.
origin: Confined to the immediate vicinity of the parish church of St Mawnan and St Stephen, near Mawnan Smith on the Helford River in south Cornwall, England.
